whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Shahi Darbar,

I noticed your restaurant has an incredible 3.7★ rating with over 800+ reviews in Bihta, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food delivery orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp ordering, menu showcase, aur table booking integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/shahidarbar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Shahi Darbar, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Shahi Darbar Raghopur) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering and your popular menu items for Bihta customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
